description: This file defines the ClaimAttachmentDecorator class in the OrangeHRM project, which acts as a decorator for the ClaimAttachment entity, providing additional methods and traits for handling claim attachments in the HRM system.

classes.name: ClaimAttachmentDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for ClaimAttachment entity, providing methods to set user references and retrieve the attachment as a string, while incorporating authentication and ORM helper traits.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the decorator with a ClaimAttachment object.

methods.name: setUserByUserId
methods.description: Sets the user for the claim attachment based on a user ID.

methods.name: getAttachment
methods.description: Returns the attachment content as a string, reading from the stored attachment stream if not already loaded.
